title: Clifftop Nine-Bedroom Estate on Cape Amarin
note: 25 m infinity pool · private chef · airport transfer
blurb: A nine-bedroom clifftop estate on the gated Cape Amarin headland between Kamala and Patong, its pavilions stepping down four levels of garden to a 25-metre infinity pool and the Andaman Sea below. A seven-bedroom main house and a separate two-bedroom sea pavilion sleep twenty, with a dining room for twenty, a gym, a games and media lounge, and a full resident team led by a private chef.
detail:
Set high on a rocky headland along Phuket's Millionaire's Mile, this estate is laid out as a series of living and sleeping pavilions cascading over four terraced garden levels, threaded with water features and landscaped into the slope. Almost every space — from the open-sided arrival lounge to the bedrooms — looks straight out over the Andaman Sea and the evening sunsets.

At its centre is a 25-metre infinity-edge pool with a shaded jacuzzi and a furnished deck, beside a semi-open barbecue pavilion with sunken seating, a bar, a pool table and a weatherproof media lounge. Indoors there is a TV lounge, karaoke, a designer guest kitchen with a breakfast island and a dining room that seats twenty, with a Sonos system running through the main living areas. Most rooms can be enjoyed open to the breeze or closed and air-conditioned, and two garden salas suit yoga, massage or a quiet afternoon.

The main house holds seven sea-view bedrooms in flexible arrangements — connecting rooms for families, two master suites with bathtubs and outdoor sitting areas, and a large family room with two king beds and a kitchenette. Below, down a long flight of garden steps, a self-contained two-bedroom sea pavilion has its own kitchen, living room and a wide balcony just above the water: ideal for a couple wanting privacy, or for honeymooners after a wedding on the estate, which hosts events for up to 80 guests. The estate can also be taken as seven or eight bedrooms for a smaller group.

The house is staffed by a guest relations manager, a villa manager, a chef and cook, housekeepers, service staff and a garden and pool team, with a fully equipped gym on site and in-villa spa treatments on request. Airport transfers are included. Kamala's beach is around ten minutes away, Surin a little further north and Patong fifteen to twenty minutes south, with the airport under an hour's drive.
